name: Kagaya Hokuto
source:
"...I don't like being home alone at night."

High school 1st-year.

He has been playing various sports since he was little, but when he entered high school, he joined the light music club for the first time. In addition, he became fascinated with Takamura's astronomical observations.

[Translated from [url=https://d10rama.com/nitousei/]official website[/url]]
